name: Mirrodin
description: Mirrodin is a plane made entirely of metal, created by Karn, that was infected with Phyrexian oil and conquered by Phyrexia.

timeline.summary: Ajani recalls that Elspeth left Dominaria for Mirrodin, which other planeswalkers now say is dead with Phyrexia returned.
timeline.quote: Then other Planeswalkers had spread the word: Mirrodin is dead. Phyrexia has returned.

citation.text: "Ajani, Mentor of Heroes" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Atraxa, a captured Mirran angel, is compleated by Elesh Norn and the other praetors except Urabrask.
timeline.quote: The praetor Elesh Norn honored the angel's tenacity with the blessed gift of Phyrexian compleation

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Karn recalls Urza teaching him about pain and the loss of Mirrodin, which he believes was his fault.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexians had taken it from him.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Echoes In The Dark" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Nahiri catches the falling earth with her magic and slows their descent to the ground.
timeline.quote: the lithomancer caught hold of them and slowed their descent

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Melira tells them she is immune to compleation and that is why the Resistance lets her roam unguarded.
timeline.quote: I'm immune. It's why the Resistance lets me move around without a guard

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, Karn recalls leaving word not to follow him when he first tried to solve Mirrodin's Phyrexian problem, and being saved by Venser's sacrifice.
timeline.quote: If it wasn't for Venser sacrificing his spark, Karn would be dead.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 7: Divine Intervention
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 7: Divine Intervention" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Karn forges Mirrodin, a plane of peace and prosperity.
timeline.quote: He forged Mirrodin, a shining metal plane of peace and prosperity that would never know about the horrors of war.

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Karn creates Mirrodin, but something goes wrong and he unwittingly introduces Phyrexian oil.
timeline.quote: He unwittingly introduced a dark contagion: Phyrexian oil.

citation.text: "Mirrodin". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Warden Karn created grows unstable and sentient, calling himself Memnarch.
timeline.quote: Even the Warden that Karn created to protect the plane grew unstable, gaining sentience and calling himself Memnarch.

citation.text: "Mirrodin". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Memnarch kidnaps countless beings from other planes before the elf Glissa Sunseeker defeats him.
timeline.quote: He kidnapped countless beings from other planes before he was finally defeated by the elf Glissa Sunseeker.

citation.text: "Mirrodin". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: New Phyrexian horrors emerge from Mirrodin's core, killing all Mirrans in their path.
timeline.quote: New Phyrexian horrors continue to emerge from Mirrodin's core, killing all Mirrans in their path

citation.text: "Mirrodin". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Urabrask's red-aligned Phyrexian faction allows Mirrodin's citizens safe harbor.
timeline.quote: Its red-aligned faction, led by Urabrask, turns a blind eye to the citizens of Mirrodin, allowing them safe harbor.

citation.text: "Mirrodin". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Memnarch slowly goes mad, abducting mortals from across the Multiverse to populate the plane.
timeline.quote: Mirrodin's caretaker Memnarch slowly went mad, abducting mortals from across the Multiverse to populate the plane.

citation.text: "New Phyrexia". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Karn brings the Phyrexian oil to Mirrodin, which begins transforming the creatures it touches.
timeline.quote: Karn was the bringer of the Phyrexian oil to Mirrodin

citation.text: "New Phyrexia". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Losing his mind, Karn becomes the Father of Machines and leader of Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Slowly losing his mind, Karn became the Father of Machines and the leader of Phyrexia.

citation.text: "New Phyrexia". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The slow spread becomes an active campaign to compleat Mirrodin, and the Mirrans are overwhelmed.
timeline.quote: The Mirrans fought many battles, but they soon were overwhelmed by the Phyrexian forces.

citation.text: "New Phyrexia". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Koth, Elspeth and Venser cannot turn the tide, and Venser sacrifices his life to restore Karn to sanity.
timeline.quote: Venser sacrificed his life to restore Karn to sanity.

citation.text: "New Phyrexia". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Praetors and their factions fight for power amongst themselves while natives struggle to survive.
timeline.quote: Now the Praetors—some of Karn's top lieutenants—and their factions fight for power amongst themselves

citation.text: "New Phyrexia". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
